Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing applications for past part-time service credit for members of the school employees' retirement system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to past part-time service credit for members of theschool employees' retirement system; and amending RCW 41.35.180.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 41.35.180 and 1998 c 341 s 19 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except for any period prior to the member's employment in aneligible position, a plan 2 or plan 3 member who is employed by aschool district or districts or an educational service district: (a) Shall receive a service credit month for each month of theperiod from September through August of the following year if he or sheis employed in an eligible position, earns compensation earnable foreight hundred ten hours or more during that period, and is employedduring nine months of that period; (b) If a member in an eligible position for each month of theperiod from September through August of the following year does notmeet the hours requirements of (a) of this subsection, the member isentitled to onehalf service credit month for each month of the periodif he or she earns earnable compensation for at least six hundred p. 1 HB 3182thirty hours but less than eight hundred ten hours during that period,and is employed nine months of that period; (c) In all other instances, a member in an eligible position isentitled to service credit months as follows: (i) One service credit month for each month in which compensationis earned for ninety or more hours; (ii) Onehalf service credit month for each month in whichcompensation is earned for at least seventy hours but less than ninetyhours; and (iii) Onequarter service credit month for each month in whichcompensation is earned for less than seventy hours. (2) Beginning on the effective date of this act and throughDecember 31, 2010, an active contributing member that: (a) Was employed in an eligible position before September 1, 1987; (b) Made member contributions for service that was not credited, asthe hours worked were insufficient to earn partial service credit forcertain months of service under the rules in place at that time; (c) Either did not withdraw, or has restored, all withdrawnservice; and (d) The hours worked before September 1, 1987, would have beensufficient for partial service credit had the service been earned undersubsection (1) of this section;may apply to the department to have those periods of partial serviceearned prior to September 1, 1987, credited to their accounts to theextent that the hours worked meet the service credit formulae insubsection (1) of this section. A member applying for periods ofpartial service must provide proof to the department of the hoursworked for any month in question according to rules adopted by thedepartment. (3) The department shall adopt rules implementing this section.
